description: sb-os component manifest. Declarative source of truth for every shippable component the installer renders into a target vault. Edit this file to add, remove, or rename a component; loaders.py reads from here. RBTV's module-manifest.json is the structural reference, adapted to sb-os's single-bundle reality (no module grouping in v1 — see architecture doc §6 'v1 ships without a separate module system').

skills.name: sb-vault-ops
skills.description: Gatekeeper for vault content and component modifications.

skills.name: sb-vault-integrity
skills.description: Post-operation structural sweep after file moves, renames, or deletes.

skills.name: sb-wiki-create-topic
skills.description: Create a wiki topic page from a candidate or freshly-proposed topic. Auto-fires when the user expresses intent to create or promote a topic.

commands.name: sb-tutor
commands.description: Tutor persona for guided learning sessions.

commands.name: sb-wiki-ingest
commands.description: Two-stage Karpathy-style ingest of a raw source into the wiki.

commands.name: sb-wiki-lint
commands.description: Structural and citation lint for the wiki; auto-syncs raw and leaf indexes.

commands.name: sb-wiki-query
commands.description: Query the wiki and synthesize an answer with grep/ripgrep Karpathy fallback (no embeddings).

rules.name: sb-sub-agents
rules.description: Pre-dispatch gate for Agent tool calls — name matching skills explicitly in sub-agent prompts.

rules.name: sb-workflow-context
rules.description: YAML context injection on workflow steps from user_context_root.

rules.name: sb-source-of-truth
rules.description: Warns that sb-os components in .claude/ are overwritten on re-install — edit at the source repo.
